title: Strix launches open-source AI pen-testing tool for live #strix #aipenetrationtesting #cybersecurity
description: Strix launched an open-source AI pen-testing tool that attacks your vibe-coded app like a hacker to find real security vulnerabilities. It uses specialized AI agents to run live attacks, providing proof of each flaw along with suggested fixes, enabling full security tests before deployment. This tool addresses growing cybersecurity concerns by automating penetration testing with AI, making robust security accessible and free for developers and small projects. Strix’s approach reduces the risk of breaches by simulating real-world hacking scenarios, improving both software safety and developer confidence. With over 45,000 stars on GitHub, Strix reflects a broader trend of AI-driven application security that enhances protection while lowering costs. It supports safer software releases and stronger defense against increasingly sophisticated cyber threats. #Strix #VibeCode #AIPenTesting #AppSecurity #Cybersecurity #OpenSourceSecurity #AIAttackSimulation #GitHubProjects #SoftwareTesting #SecurityAutomation #AIForDevelopers #PenetrationTesting #HackSimulation #CyberDefense #FreeSecurityTool
